answer: The rule groups identities by their behavioural signature and applies the penalty to the whole group at once. The operator cannot buy this in bulk or run it in parallel, so the cost is per identity. The signal is the collateral at risk, the orchard the behavioural signature that groups identities, and the spiral the joint forfeiture that punishes the group: splitting into many orchard groups avoids the joint loss but scatters the signal into smaller, individually useless stakes.
